name: LNA Sante SA
summary: LNA Santé SA operates and manages full-care facilities for the dependent elderly persons under the LNA Santé brand in France and Belgium. The company operates nursing homes, follow-up care and rehabilitation facilities, home hospitalization structures, health centers, and psychiatric clinics. It serves patients with complex, acute, or chronic pathologies comprising neurological, respiratory, cardiovascular, psychiatric, etc. The company operates 11 clinics; 1 psychiatric clinic; and 7 home care facilities. LNA Santé SA was founded in 1990 and is based in Vertou, France.
